text.description_html:
Double Door Panic Bar Strike Plate

For use with Global Door Controls Touch Bar Rim Exit Device TH1100EDTBAR, Exit Device TH1100EDTBARSS, Exit Device ED-501-DU, Exit Device ED-501-AL and Alarm Exit Device ED-501ALARM-AL

Also available: for single doors, Panic Bar Strike Plate

For double doors - Use when installing a Vertical Rod Panic Device on one door and a Rim Exit Panic Device on the other door.

Features and Specifications of the Panic Device Strike Plate:

  • Overall Width: 2-7/8"
  • Overall Height: 2-5/8"
  • Finish: Aluminum Paint
  • Packaged with mounting screws.

Sold Individually
